text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is registered for the
Takarazuka
Kinen, where her sister, Biwa
Hayahide, will also
be racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finally, the two of them have a
once-in-a-lifetime
chance to face each
other at their very best. The
curtains rise
on their sisterly showdown!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
